code: if (fname[0] == 0)          /* fopen_proc gets NUL terminated string, not len */
note: A filename beginning with NUL is treated as an empty string by this check, even though the caller supplied a non-empty byte sequence.

code: return 0;               /* so this is the same as len == 0, so return NULL */
note: The safety obligation is that a NUL-prefixed filename must not be conflated with a true zero-length filename; otherwise the stream object is left in a broken partially initialized state.
Later stream operations assume a valid file-backed stream object; the broken object can reach file/stream handling paths and crash when dereferenced or finalized.
